description.ja: ジ・オリジンＭＳＤで考察されるＭＳの系譜をＨＧキットで再現！
description.en: The genealogy of MS considered in The Origin MSD is reproduced with HGKit!

description.ja: 水中で威力を発揮する数々の火力武器を装備した“ ＲＡＧ－７９－Ｇ１ 水中型ガンダム”が登場！！
description.en: Introducing the “RAG-79-G1 Underwater Gundam” equipped with a number of firepower weapons that are effective underwater! !

description.ja: 『機動戦士ガンダム ＴＨＥ ＯＲＩＧＩＮ』ＭＳＤ（Ｍｏｂｉｌｅ Ｓｕｉｔｓ Ｄｉｓｃｏｖｅｒｙ）より、
description.en: From "Mobile Suit Gundam THE ORIGIN" MSD (Mobile Suits Discovery),

description.ja: 水中型ガンダムをＨＧシリーズキットで商品化。
description.en: Commercialize underwater Gundam with HG series kit.

description.ja: 印象深いカラーリングを成形色で再現し、特徴的な部位や武装を新規造形で徹底再現！
description.en: The impressive coloring is reproduced with molded colors, and the characteristic parts and weapons are thoroughly reproduced with new molding!

description.ja: ●　ＭＳの特徴的な各部位を新規造形で再現！
description.en: ● Reproduce each characteristic part of MS with new modeling!

description.ja: 頭部、外装、バックパックなど、全身に渡る特徴的な各部位を、ディテール豊かな新規造形で徹底再現。
description.en: Each characteristic part of the body, including the head, exterior, and backpack, has been thoroughly reproduced with new modeling rich in detail.

description.ja: 部分的に局地型ガンダムの意匠が見られる。
description.en: Local Gundam designs can be seen in some parts.

description.ja: ・　水中での機動性を向上させる大型バックパックを装備。
description.en: - Equipped with a large backpack that improves underwater mobility.

description.ja: ・　バイザータイプの特徴的な頭部を再現。
description.en: - Reproduces the characteristic head of the visor type.

description.ja: バイザーはクリアパーツで再現し、内部のツインアイも再現。後頭部には頭部潜望鏡を配備。
description.en: The visor is reproduced with clear parts, and the twin eyes inside are also reproduced. A head periscope is installed on the back of the head.

description.ja: ・　局地型ガンダムと、大幅に形状が異なる外装を徹底再現。
description.en: - Thoroughly reproduces the exterior, which is significantly different in shape from the local Gundam.

description.ja: ●　数々の武器を再現！
description.en: ● Reproduce numerous weapons!

description.ja: 偏向ビーム・ライフル、ハープーン・ガン、ハンドアンカー等の印象深い武器を新規型で付属。
description.en: New impressive weapons such as a deflection beam rifle, harpoon gun, and hand anchor are included.

description.ja: 各種武器には遊びの幅が広がるギミックを搭載。
description.en: Various weapons are equipped with gimmicks that expand the range of play.

description.ja: ◆　偏向ビーム・ライフル
description.en: ◆ Deflector Beam Rifle

description.ja: 水中での使用が想定され、ビームを細く収束させる形状の砲身をもつ、専用の水中型ライフルを再現。
description.en: Reproduces a special underwater rifle that is designed to be used underwater and has a barrel shaped to narrowly converge the beam.

description.ja: 取外しが可能なライフルカバーが付属。
description.en: Comes with a removable rifle cover.

description.ja: ◆　ハープーン・ガン
description.en: ◆ Harpoon Gun

description.ja: 左腕には、炸裂式のモリを射出するハープーン・ガンを装備。
description.en: The left arm is equipped with a harpoon gun that fires an explosive harpoon.

description.ja: ハープーン・ガンは、腕からの取外しができ、手持ち武器として使用可能。グリップ部のくり出し構造を採用。
description.en: The harpoon gun can be removed from the arm and used as a handheld weapon. Adopts a protruding grip structure.

description.ja: ◆　ハンドアンカー
description.en: ◆ Hand anchor

description.ja: 右腕には、ハンドアンカーを装備。リード線が付属し、射出状態を再現可能。
description.en: Equipped with a hand anchor on the right arm. A lead wire is included and the injection state can be reproduced.

description.ja: ◆　ビーム・ピック
description.en: ◆ Beam pick

description.ja: 右腰に携行装備をするビーム・ピックを２本付属。ビーム刃が付属し、手持ち武器としても使用可能。
description.en: Two beam picks are included to carry on the right hip. Comes with a beam blade and can be used as a handheld weapon.

description.ja: 右腰には、収納用ラックを再現。ビーム・ピックは、それぞれ取外しが可能。
description.en: A storage rack is reproduced on the right hip. Each beam pick can be removed.

description.ja: ●　オリジナルマーキングが、新規デザインで付属！
description.en: ● Original Marking is included with a new design!

description.ja: 付属武装 ： 偏向ビーム・ライフル（ライフルカバー付属） ／ ハープーン・ガン ／ ビーム・ピック
description.en: Attached weapons: Deflector beam rifle (rifle cover included) / Harpoon gun / Beam pick
